Founder · Ottawa

Work is complicated enough. The tools should help.

I’m Rob Saric. I build software for small teams and write about making work simpler: what to fix, where AI can help, and what’s better left human.

The goal isn’t to fit more work into life. It’s to make more room for life outside it.

narrative.overview:
The site feels like a personal editorial space: direct, generous, and interested in the people doing the work. Large geometric headings give the writing conviction; open margins and quiet reading text keep the experience approachable. Reading routes retain cool paper and deep ink. The approved homepage variant uses warm cream paper, charcoal text, the same vivid blue, and an unbranded rectangular portrait.

Asymmetry establishes the larger compositions, while thin rules and aligned text give the writing structure. Blue connects headings, links, and actions across both palettes. Yellow remains a small accent for selection and dark-surface keyboard feedback. The system follows the approved personal-site direction and its October 19 homepage update. The old clinic-focused artboards remain historical references; the warm homepage does not restore their palette or composition.
keyCharacteristics: Expressive Manrope headings paired with steady Inter reading text.
Cool reading pages and a warm homepage share vivid blue and occasional yellow.
Open editorial lists and projects, with selective flat tonal sections.
An unbranded rectangular homepage portrait; the About portrait retains its arch.
Responsive stacking, visible keyboard focus, and complete content without JavaScript.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use blue focus on light surfaces and yellow focus on blue or ink. Yellow carries ink text when it becomes a control surface.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep continuous prose within 68ch. Express hierarchy through size, weight, space, and real headings. The approved founder/Ottawa identity line is a homepage exception to the avoidance of decorative eyebrow text; it is ordinary sentence-case metadata, not a new global kicker style.

rules.name: The Open Structure Rule
rules.body: Use aligned text and thin rules for repeated writing and project entries. Use tonal sections selectively for an invitation or the homepage personal introduction.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal changes and rules for depth; reserve the existing shadow for the mobile navigation overlay.

dos: **Do** preserve the cool reading palette and use the approved warm neutrals only through the homepage theme; blue and yellow remain shared.
**Do** keep the Manrope and Inter pairing and the 68ch maximum reading measure.
**Do** use thin rules, aligned text, and open spacing for repeated entries.
